items.title: 10.9 Amount of substance produced during electrolysis (electrolysis mein banne wale substance ki miqdar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.9 with Sample Problem 10.5, printed page 222.

blocks.text: F ki value se electrode par jamne wale substance ki mass aur electrode par banne wali gas ka volume nikala ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 10.5
blocks.problem: Pighle hue lead(II) bromide (PbBr₂) mein 20.0 min tak 1.50 A current guzarta hai. Cathode par kitna lead (Pb) jamega? (Pb ka Ar = 207; F = 96500 C mol⁻¹)
steps: Step 2: 1 mole Pb ke liye 2 moles electrons, yani 2F = 2 × 96500 = 193000 C chahiye.
Step 3: Guzra hua charge: Q = I × t = 1.50 A × (20 × 60) s = 1.50 × 1200 = 1800 C
Step 4: Proportion (tanasub): 193000 C se 207 g Pb jamta hai, to 1800 C se (1800 / 193000) × 207 = 1.93 g jamega.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har sawal ke chaar step (qadam): half-equation likhein → 1 mole ke liye charge (n × 96500 C) → guzra charge Q = I × t (time seconds mein!) → simple proportion se mass. Minutes ko 60 se multiply karna na bhoolein.

blocks.prompt: Pighle NaCl mein 0.50 A current 965 s tak guzre to cathode par kitna sodium (Ar 23) jamega?

items: F se jami hui mass ya gas ka volume nikalta hai.
Sample 10.5: Q = 1800 C, 1 mole Pb ko 193000 C, mass = 1.93 g.
